root_cause_criterion.description: When decode_file honors option_values.force_extensible_wave_format, it must also set output_format = FORMAT_WAVE before the foreign-metadata compatibility check. The vulnerable branch only sets output_subformat = SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE, so the AIFF-C format selected from foreign metadata survives into later decode state.

nodes.description: At the sink line, decoder_session->format is still FORMAT_AIFF_C, preserving the stale AIFF-C format selected upstream from foreign metadata.
At the sink line, decoder_session->subformat is SUBFORMAT_WAVE_EXTENSIBLE, preserving the forced wave-extensible subformat that makes the AIFF-C pair impossible.

edges.description: The output_format chosen at the force-extensible branch is copied unchanged into decode_options.format before flac__decode_file is called.
The forced output_subformat is copied unchanged into decode_options.force_subformat before flac__decode_file is called.
DecoderSession_construct stores decode_options.format into d->format without rewriting the carried format value.
DecoderSession_construct stores decode_options.force_subformat into d->subformat without rewriting the carried subformat value.
The d->format value stored in DecoderSession_construct is the same decoder_session->format observed at the write_callback sink line.
The d->subformat value stored in DecoderSession_construct is the same decoder_session->subformat observed at the write_callback sink line.
